questions.q: How many extracts are on Paper 1 Listening?
questions.why: Questions are set on eight short recorded extracts, at least one from each area of study.

questions.q: Which of these is a focus work for the Romantic area of study?
questions.why: Vltava from Má vlast is the Romantic focus work; the others are Baroque or Classical.

questions.q: What is the weighting of Paper 1 Listening?
questions.why: Paper 1 is 70 marks and 40% of the qualification; Performing and Composing are 30% each.

questions.q: The focus works are not used in the exam. Explain what this means for how you should revise them.
questions.model: Exam extracts are different pieces related in genre, structure or style, so I should learn the features the focus works show (e.g. ritornello, sonata form, programme music) and be able to recognise them in unfamiliar music.
points: learn the features/style, not the piece itself
